slices.description: Filesystem evidence ONLY: registered git worktrees and any stray/orphaned/de-registered glpnet working copy anywhere on the D: drive. Directory listings, .git file/dir contents, working-tree status, untracked-file hoards. Do NOT consult refs/heads, refs/remotes, the GitHub API, or specs/.

Local git ref evidence ONLY: every local branch that is not the active feature branch. Ahead/behind vs develop and main, merge-base, commit sets, changed-file sets, code-vs-chore classification, reflog. Do NOT consult the filesystem outside .git, refs/remotes, the GitHub API, or specs/.

Remote and GitHub evidence ONLY: origin remote heads, tags, pull requests in every state, releases, workflow runs, branch protection. Do NOT consult local refs/heads, the local filesystem outside .git/refs/remotes, or specs/.

Pipeline artifact evidence ONLY: per-feature spec.md / plan.md / tasks.md / research.md completeness and stage state, plus .specify pipeline and roadmap state. Do NOT consult git refs (local or remote), the GitHub API, or the filesystem outside these trees.
